user.title: Add a printer
user.description: Point OrcaSlicer (host type Octo/Klipper) at `{url}` with a Home Assistant long-lived access token as API key. Each sliced file is routed to the printer whose name or alias matches the `orcastrator_printer = MyPrinter` tag (printer Notes in OrcaSlicer) or the OrcaSlicer printer preset name.

data_description.name: Also the value of the `orcastrator_printer` tag in the G-code.
data_description.power_entity: Turned on when a job arrives and the printer is offline or its power switch is off.
data_description.aliases: Other names that route to this printer, e.g. the exact OrcaSlicer printer preset name.

advanced.name: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Power-on automation, boot timings, Klipper restart behavior, idle power-off, and error notifications.

data.firmware_restart: Firmware restart if Klipper boots into an error
data.graceful_shutdown: Shut down Moonraker host before cutting power

data_description.auto_power_on: Automatically turn on the configured power switch when a job arrives for an offline or switched-off printer.
data_description.boot_timeout: Maximum time to wait for Klipper to report ready after a job arrives.
data_description.firmware_restart: Sends FIRMWARE_RESTART when a freshly powered printer boots with a recoverable MCU connection error. Never done for thermal, E-stop, or already-running printer errors.
data_description.max_restarts: Maximum number of automatic FIRMWARE_RESTART attempts per job.
data_description.poll_interval: How often to poll Moonraker while waiting for Klipper to become ready.
data_description.error_grace: How long Klipper must stay in error/shutdown before triggering FIRMWARE_RESTART or failing.
data_description.restart_backoff: Minimum wait between consecutive FIRMWARE_RESTART attempts.
data_description.notify_on_error: Show a Home Assistant persistent notification when a job fails or cannot start automatically.
data_description.auto_power_off: Automatically turn off the power switch once the printer has been idle (not printing, no active heaters) and cooled down.
data_description.idle_timeout: How long the printer must stay idle with no active print or target heater temperatures before powering off.
data_description.cooldown_temp: Wait until all extruders cool below this temperature before cutting power.
data_description.graceful_shutdown: Send a clean OS shutdown request to Moonraker and wait for it to halt before turning off the smart plug.

error.invalid_url: Invalid URL (use http/https without query parameters, fragments, or embedded credentials).
error.invalid_name: The name needs at least one letter or digit.
error.invalid_alias: Each alias needs at least one letter or digit.
error.alias_conflict: One of the aliases is already used by another printer.
error.invalid_timing: Must be smaller than the boot timeout.
error.already_configured: Another printer already uses this name or alias.

abort.already_configured: A printer with this name already exists.
